usedFor: Shopify holds shoppers and carts, and Salesblink keeps outreach lists through “Add Leads To List”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Add Leads To List” in Salesblink
bestTemplate.why: People who left a checkout become leads on a list, ready for a follow-up sequence.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify is polling, so leads join the list after a scheduled check.
